observations.observation: 羽蛇甲头为浅骷髅面配绿羽外圈与小金尖，胸中央黑空口内金黄焦点、左右绿红肩羽，下方细白骨围腰红带，棕靴配浅灰胫片。新增1个保守骷髅羽冠/骨羽肩带学习组，但稀疏胸带不是普通封闭胸甲的成稿样板，仍非有效完整独立总数验收。四图16像素有限色块使羽/骨/皮靴可区分，两个128×64原图绿羽和红色绳/片很多附属岛；只学骨白、羽绿、皮褐的材料对比，避免大羽冠抢走盔甲本体和每像素零碎挂件。
暗绿灰皮革、浅骨护额和简单短靴，大色面支持皮甲身份；不把另两种巨魔颜色另算结构。
绿灰、蓝灰和深青为同款方皮胸、细直护腿与骨护额；三色合并。皮革正面一整亮块、边缘更暗，不依赖密集斑点。
灰褐铁木甲只用小浅绿钉/扣装饰，肩胸裤脚均保持大灰面。库存四部位和穿戴两层是一套，亮扣位置一致可学，不能照搬排列。
仅头件，蓝白顶块配几层绿叶。粗层片组织明确，用于学习植物身份，不推断不存在的胸裤靴。
斜叶胸片和相连裤腰、深绿腿边区分于娜迦大胸心；两种绿色装备有实际纹样结构差异。用几片大斜阶梯表达叶材，避免满身细碎鳞点。
棕色胸板和肩块由大色面组成，裤腿和膝块清晰；只看到胸和裤，不以缺部位补图凑数。

Main_findings: Viewed all three original author integer-nearest analysis sheets: 8 source item icons plus two original 64x64 wear atlases, and all 15 Wildwood/13 Sylvan raw UV-size nets. These are source analysis sheets, not native wearing screenshots or newly made art.

Wildwood: orange-brown branches, a long central face slat, dark/transparent eye-mouth gaps, paired broad chest slats and detached shoulder knots; transverse shin joints and two block feet. Yellow wood highlights and dark end/gap blocks serve wood material; no humanoid illustration. Do not copy fine grain into Dynasty target pixels.

Sylvan: broad warm off-white plates over green cloth at forehead/boot cuffs, brown branch fasteners, blue-white/red-yellow/purple-green small chest flower clusters. Light shin panels differ from wood joints. Dense grey atlas checker grain and elaborate leaf/branch head silhouette do not become ordinary Dynasty armor proportions.

Each family has four actual native registry slots and eight complete generated item JSONs collectively. Item layer0 is roots:items/<ID> (plural items), separate from dedicated 64x64 wear atlas. Per-slot cached model selection rejects non-ARMOR. No inferred vanilla layer1/layer2 contract.

All 60+53 source box declarations, parent addChild, origins, sizes, literal pivots, radian rotations and UV bounds match saved correspondence. Model mirror=true occurs after addBox; final field is not proof of baked mirroring because exact ModelBox construction consumer remains unread.

Wildwood applies chest childY-1, leg/boot childY-12 and armorScale1.2. Sylvan applies head childY+1, leg/boot childY-12 and armorScale1.1. Initial rootY-12 is not final world position; base render follows biped poses and applies later scale/translation.

Full fixed-upstream ModelArmorBase creates eight 64x64 roots, chooses HEAD/head; CHEST/chest+arms; LEGS/legs; FEET/boots. Adult render separately scales torso/limbs and translates lower roots. Child path in this bounded source does not call renderArms; this is not a reproduced current bug or authorization to change production.

Subclass public slot shadows base slot but base constructor stores passed slot used by base render. Ordinary angles delegate biped; ArmorStand angles convert degrees to radians. Exact runtime dependency and game version consumer differ from current Dynasty.

Registration chain bounded read: RegistryManager content event calls ModItems init; eight native item registrations; LibRegistry shared initAll posts RegisterContentEvent then registers items and invokes IModeledObject.initModel on model event. handler ModelResourceLocation resolver not read/executed.

Compared full saved observations of six existing skull/feather harness, forest-troll hide, ironwood-rivet, leaf headgear, steeleaf plate, and partial wooden chest/leg groups. These are saved textual judgments only, not new raw pixel/source reviews or exhaustive novelty. Two related branch-and-panel sets conservatively form at most ONE complete learning mechanism; slots, cubes, source files and raw nets add zero.

Potential application: bamboo/wood armor may learn branch fastener versus broad panel material separation while retaining vanilla block silhouette and discrete large pixel shading. Current target summary is not evidence all seven family original assets were freshly inspected, redrawn or authorized for overwrite.
